findings.description: The code performs an unchecked cast from the result of `contractABits.read()` to `HUSB238_5VCurrentContract`.
The code doesn't check if the I2C operations succeed.
The code doesn't verify that `i2c_dev` is valid before using it.
No error handling for I2C communication failures.
The 2-bit value read from the register (0-3 range) is not validated before casting to the enum.
